    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MySQL 性能调优完全指南：从硬件到 SQL，一篇吃透</span>
    

</a>

        </h1>
        <div class="postbody">
            <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<blockquote>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__1">MySQL 性能调优是后端开发与运维的必备技能。然而，调优并非单一操作，而是涉及硬件、配置、架构、SQL 等多个维度的系统工程。本文结合实战笔记，系统梳理 MySQL 性能优化的方法论与核心技巧，助你快速定位瓶颈、提升数据库吞吐量。</span></span></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__1">一、优化从何入手？</span></span></strong></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__2">数据库处理一个请求，会经过客户端连接、查询缓存、SQL 解析、查询优化、存储引擎、磁盘 I/O 等多个环节，每个环节都可能成为瓶颈。</span></span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426121618728-193704073.png" alt="image-20230827194457356" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__3">优化维度全景图</span></span></span></strong></p>
<table style="height: 253px; width: 981px">
<thead>
<tr><th><span class="js_darkmode__4">维度</span></th><th data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__5">常见手段</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__6">硬件</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__7">使用 SSD、RAID10 阵列、增加内存</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__8">连接</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__9">调整&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__10">max_connections</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__11">、减少应用端连接数</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__12">配置</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__13">优化&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__14">innodb_buffer_pool_size</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__15">、日志刷新策略</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__16">缓存</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__17">引入 Redis/Memcached 做前置缓存</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__18">架构</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__19">主从复制、读写分离、分库分表</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__20">SQL &amp; 索引</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="289"><span class="js_darkmode__21">慢查询分析、执行计划优化、索引设计</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__23">二、硬件与基础配置优化</span></span></span></strong></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__24"><span>2.1 硬件建议</span></span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__25">磁盘</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__26">：使用 RAID10（兼顾 RAID0 的性能 + RAID1 的可靠性）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__27">内存</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__28">：越大越好，InnoDB 会将其用作缓存</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__29">CPU</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__30">：高频优于多核（多数场景）</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span class="js_darkmode__30"><span class="js_darkmode__30">&nbsp;</span></span>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__32"><span>2.2 关键 MySQL 配置（my.cnf）</span></span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;"># InnoDB 缓冲池大小（专用服务器建议设置物理内存的 70%~80%）
innodb_buffer_pool_size = 4G

# 连接数
max_connections = 500
max_user_connections = 50

# 日志刷盘策略（非金融级可设为 2 提升写入性能）
innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit = 2
sync_binlog = 1

# 独立表空间
innodb_file_per_table = 1

# 慢查询日志
slow_query_log = 1
long_query_time = 0.5
slow_query_log_file = /var/lib/mysql/mysql-slow.log

# 默认存储引擎
default-storage-engine = InnoDB
</pre>
</div>
<blockquote>
<p>说明：innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit = 2 表示每秒刷盘，性能好但可能丢失 1 秒数据；=1 最安全但最慢</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__33"><span>三、架构优化</span></span></h2>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__34">当单库无法承载负载时，需要从架构层面突破</span></p>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__35">历史演进</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426122022255-31240832.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__37"><span>3.1 主从复制与读写分离</span></span></h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426122119833-2029839229.png" alt="1354459428" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__39">异步复制</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__40">：主库提交后立即返回，不等待从库。延迟可能较大。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__41">半同步复制</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__42">：至少一个从库接收 binlog 并写入 relay log 后才返回。可减少数据丢失风险。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__43">启用半同步（需安装插件）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">-- 主库安装
INSTALL PLUGIN rpl_semi_sync_master SONAME 'semisync_master.so';
-- 从库安装
INSTALL PLUGIN rpl_semi_sync_slave SONAME 'semisync_slave.so';
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__44">GTID 复制</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__45">：全局事务 ID，简化主从切换和故障恢复。开启方式：</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">gtid_mode = ON
enforce_gtid_consistency = ON
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　<strong data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__46"><span>读写分离</span></span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__47"><span>：借助中间件（如 ProxySQL、HAProxy）将写请求发往主库，读请求均衡分发到从库。</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426122355390-463977110.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__48"><span>3.2 高可用方案对比</span></span></h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>方案</span></th><th><span>特点</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>MHA / MMM</span></td>
<td><span>成熟，需要多个节点，切换时间秒级</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>MGR（MySQL Group Replication）</span></td>
<td><span>官方原生，支持多主，强一致性</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Galera Cluster</span></td>
<td><span>多主同步，无延迟，但写扩展有限</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Keepalived + 主从</span></td>
<td><span>简单，但需要配合虚拟 IP 和脚本</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__49"><span>3.3 分库分表</span></span></h3>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__50">当单表数据量达到千万级甚至亿级，分库分表是必然选择。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__51">垂直分库</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__52">：按业务模块拆分（如订单库、用户库），降低单库压力。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__53">垂直分表</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__54">：将宽表切分成主表 + 扩展表（如把&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__55">text</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__56">、<code><span class="js_darkmode__57">blob</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__58">&nbsp;字段独立）。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__59">水平分表</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__60">：按某个键（如用户 ID、时间）将数据分散到多张结构相同的表中。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div><span class="js_darkmode__60">&nbsp;<strong>单库</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426122528571-830466462.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;垂直分库</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426122731430-2027379721.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;垂直分表</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/605714/202604/605714-20260426122812038-843162625.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<strong data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__64"><span>逆规范化</span></span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__65"><span>：适当增加冗余字段，减少 JOIN 查询，提高读性能。适合读多写少的场景。</span></span></p>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__66"><span>四、SQL 优化实战</span></span></h2>
<h3><span class="js_darkmode__67"><span>4.1 打开慢查询日志</span></span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">SET GLOBAL slow_query_log = ON;
SET GLOBAL long_query_time = 0.5;   -- 0.5 秒
</pre>
</div>
<h3><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__68">使用&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__69">mysqldumpslow</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__70">&nbsp;分析：</span></span></span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">mysqldumpslow -s t -t 20 /var/lib/mysql/mysql-slow.log
</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__71"><span>4.2 使用 profiling 查询单条 SQL 耗时</span></span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">SET profiling = 1;
SELECT * FROM user WHERE id = 1;
SHOW PROFILES;
SHOW PROFILE FOR QUERY 1;
</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__72"><span>4.3 EXPLAIN 执行计划分析</span></span></h3>
<p><code><span class="js_darkmode__73">EXPLAIN</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__74">&nbsp;是 SQL 优化的核心工具。示例：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">EXPLAIN SELECT t.tname, c.cname, tc.phone
FROM teacher t, course c, teacher_contact tc
WHERE t.tid = c.tid AND t.tcid = tc.tcid AND (c.cid = 2 OR tc.tcid = 3);
</pre>
</div>
<h3><strong data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__75"><span>关键列解读：</span></span></strong></h3>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<table style="height: 344px; width: 1026px">
<thead>
<tr><th><span>列名</span></th><th><span>含义</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__77">id</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__78">查询序号，越大越先执行；相同则顺序执行</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__79">select_type</span></strong></td>
<td><code><span class="js_darkmode__80">SIMPLE</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__81">（简单查询）、<code><span class="js_darkmode__82">PRIMARY</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__83">（主查询）、<code><span class="js_darkmode__84">S</span></code><code><span class="js_darkmode__85">UBQUERY</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__86"><br><span class="js_darkmode__87">（子查询）、<code><span class="js_darkmode__88">DERIVED</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__89">（派生表）、<code><span class="js_darkmode__90">UNION</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__91">&nbsp;等</span></span></span></span></span></span></td>



</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__92">type</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__93">连接类型，<strong><span class="js_darkmode__94">性能从高到低</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__95">：<code><span class="js_darkmode__96">system</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__97">&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__98">const</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__99">&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__100">eq_ref</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__101">&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__102">ref</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__103">&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__104">range</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__105">&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__106">index</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__107">&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__108">ALL</span></code></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></td>



</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__109">possible_keys</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__110">可能用到的索引</span></td>



</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__111">key</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__112">实际使用的索引</span></td>



</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__113">key_len</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__114">使用的索引长度（字节），帮助判断联合索引中使用了哪些列</span></td>



</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__115">rows</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__116">预估扫描的行数</span></td>



</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong><span class="js_darkmode__117">Extra</span></strong></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__118">额外信息，如&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__119">Using index</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__120">（覆盖索引）、<code><span class="js_darkmode__121">Using filesort</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__122">（文件排序，需要优化）、<code><span class="js_darkmode__123">Using temporary</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__124">（使用临时表）</span></span></span></span></td>



</tr>



</tbody>


</table>

<br>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__125"><span>type 优化目标</span></span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__126"><span>：至少达到&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__127">range</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__128">，争取&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__129">ref</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__130">&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__131">const</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__132">。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><span class="js_darkmode__133">小技巧</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__134">：<code><span class="js_darkmode__135">key_len</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__136">&nbsp;计算示例（utf8mb4 每个字符 4 字节）<span><br><span class="js_darkmode__137">若&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__138">phone varchar(11)</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__139">&nbsp;且&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__140">utf8mb4</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__141">，索引长度 ≈ 11×4 + 2 = 46 字节。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

</blockquote>
<h2><span>五、索引与表结构优化</span></h2>
<h3><span>5.1 索引使用原则</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__143">在 WHERE、JOIN、ORDER BY、GROUP BY 涉及的列上建立索引</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__144">区分度高的列优先</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__145">联合索引遵循<strong><span class="js_darkmode__146">最左前缀</span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__147">原则</span></span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__148">避免索引失效：<code><span class="js_darkmode__149">LIKE '%xxx'</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__150">、函数操作、隐式类型转换、OR 条件等</span></span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<h3><span>5.2 表结构优化实例</span></h3>
<p>垂直拆分<span>（适用于表过宽或含大字段）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">- 原表
CREATE TABLE article (id INT, title VARCHAR(200), content TEXT, ...);
-- 拆分后
CREATE article_base (id INT, title VARCHAR(200));
CREATE article_content (id INT, content TEXT);
</pre>
</div>
<p>　<strong data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span class="js_darkmode__151"><span>水平拆分</span></span></strong><span class="js_darkmode__152">（按时间或 ID 范围）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">-- 按年份分区，或使用应用层路由到 order_2023、order_2024 等
</pre>
</div>
<p><span class="js_darkmode__153"><span>六、锁机制与死锁分析</span></span></p>
<h3><span>6.1 InnoDB 锁类型</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>行锁<span>：锁定单行记录（Record Lock）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>间隙锁<span>：锁定范围（Gap Lock），防止幻读</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Next-Key Lock<span>&nbsp;= 行锁 + 间隙锁，RR 隔离级别下默认使用</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>6.2 死锁的四个必要条件</span></h3>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1">
<li>
<p><span>两个或以上事务</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>锁资源不兼容（排他锁互斥）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>每个事务持有锁并申请新锁</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>循环等待</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>示例死锁演示<span>：</span></p>
<table style="height: 137px; width: 935px">
<thead>
<tr><th><span class="js_darkmode__154">事务 A</span></th><th><span class="js_darkmode__155">事务 B</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code><span class="js_darkmode__156">BEGIN； SELECT * FROM user WHERE id=3 FOR UPDATE;</span></code></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__157">&nbsp;</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>&nbsp;</span></td>
<td><code><span class="js_darkmode__158">BEGIN； DELETE FROM user WHERE id=4;</span></code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code><span class="js_darkmode__159">UPDATE user SET name='mimi' WHERE id=4;</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__160">（等待 B 释放）</span></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__161">（等待 A 释放 id=3 的锁）→ 死锁</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3><span>6.3 查看与处理死锁</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">-- 查看当前锁等待的信息
SHOW STATUS LIKE 'innodb_row_lock%';

-- 查看正在运行的事务
SELECT * FROM information_schema.innodb_trx;

-- 查看锁详细信息（MySQL 8.0）
SELECT * FROM performance_schema.data_locks;
SELECT * FROM sys.innodb_lock_waits;
</pre>
</div>
<p><span>发现阻塞线程后，可使用&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__162">KILL &lt;thread_id&gt;</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__163">&nbsp;终<span>止。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>6.4 避免死锁的建议</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>多表操作按固定顺序<span>访问</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>将大事务拆分为多个小事务</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>降低隔离级别（如 RR → RC，可减少间隙锁）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>为表添加合理索引，避免表锁升级</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>七、常用监控命令速查</span></h2>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">-- 查看当前连接
SHOW PROCESSLIST;
SELECT * FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST;

-- 查看各 SQL 执行次数
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Com_%';

-- 查看服务端变量
SHOW VARIABLES LIKE '%connect%';
SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'slow_query_log';

-- 查看表锁情况
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'table_locks%';

-- 查看打开文件数
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'open_files';
</pre>
</div>
<h2><span>八、总结：调优路线图</span></h2>
<table style="height: 217px; width: 1132px">
<thead>
<tr><th><span class="js_darkmode__165">阶段</span></th><th><span class="js_darkmode__166">核心动作</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__167">1. 硬件层</span></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__168">升级 SSD、增加内存、使用 RAID10</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__169">2. 配置层</span></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__170">调整&nbsp;<code><span class="js_darkmode__171">innodb_buffer_pool_size</span></code><span class="js_darkmode__172">、连接数、日志刷盘策略</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__173">3. 架构层</span></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__174">读写分离、主从半同步、分库分表、引入缓存</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__175">4. SQL 层</span></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__176">开启慢查询日志、分析 EXPLAIN、优化索引、避免全表扫描</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__177">5. 锁层面</span></td>
<td><span class="js_darkmode__178">减少长事务、合理设计索引、降低隔离级别（若业务允许）</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>最后，记住一条真理：没有任何一次调优是“无脑加配置”能解决的，必须结合业务特点与监控数据，循序渐进。</p>
